tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// gza' thams cad kyi yum rje btsun rig pa chen mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang mchod chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rje btsun ma gza' rnams kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du yum chen mo bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig phan tshun chags pa dang sdang ba med cing mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs par gyur cig snyam du tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dha rmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas rdo rje la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma gza'i yum du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo zhing cung zad khro ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bkod nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros par rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ dri ma thams cad dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de lta bu'i lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de sems mnyam par gzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa sgrib pa/ nad dang bar du gcod pa rnams sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas rang la bstim/ gza' dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi gdug pa'i sems zhi bar byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi d+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa t+yai swā hā/ zhes nye snying gang mos la ci nus su bzlas so// bzlas pa tshar ba dang oṃ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas dkar gtong sbyang pa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rin po che'i snod lha'i bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas gang bar bskyed/

oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇām̐/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor ma'i mgron rnams kyi bzhes pa'i don thams cad 'byung bar bsam/ de nas rang skad cig gis yum chen mor mos pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsams zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam/ de nas de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir/ yum gyi mdo 'don pa la sogs pa bya/ mthar bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// gza' rnams kyi yum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa/ las dang po pa rnams kyi don du/ 'phags pas me pho bye ba'i lo khra'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum la thang skyar sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni ā tsa ra'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa// bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad pa mo// rig pa'i rgyal mo la btud nas// de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya// skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum sku mdog dkar mo/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang na bza' can no// gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī swā hā/ zhes pa nye snying gang nus su bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang*// gza' dang rgyu skar gdon rnams kyi// nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi mdzad pa// rig pa'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod// ces bstod/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ badz+ra dz+wa la'i sngags rgyas gang bar byas/ a kā ros bzhed don 'grub par byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba bi d+yā sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba lin gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams byas la/ de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir gzungs mdo 'don par bya zhing*/ mthar yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skabs dang 'dra'o// 'gro kun dge legs mdzad pa yi// lha mo'i sgrub thabs rab dga' ba// shin tu rgyas pa'i snying po nyid// gzhan la phan phyir bkod pa yin// gza' yum rig pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel// ༈ /gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi tho bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i gza' yum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i gang zag gis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par byas/

swa bhā ba'i sngags brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi drang srong gza' yi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gza' thams cad kyi yum rje btsun ma rig pa chen mo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo zhing cung zad khro ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje sngon po dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du āḥlas nyi ma dmar ser dka' thub kyi cha byad can phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ nyi ma bye ba'i tsha zer 'phro ba/ shar gyi 'dab ma la soḥlas zla ba dkar po bram ze'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can g.yas bgrangs phreng dang*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lhor am̐ las mig dmar dmar po dge slong gi gzugs 'dzin pa/ gos dmar po dang cod pan can g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon shak+ti 'dzin pa/ nub tu buḥlas lhag pa ser po smra ra dmar po dang ldan pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can g.yas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ byang du briḥlas phur bu ser po sma ra dmar po dang ldan pa/

sha rgyas pa dge slong gi rnam pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shuḥlas pa sangs dkar po ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyugs bdag gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu shaḥlas spen pa ljang gu phyogs kyi gos can sma ra dang*/ ral pa ser skya'i cod pan can/ g.yas mdung g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ nub byang du rāḥlas sgra gcan dmar nag thod pa dang ldan pa/ lus phyed nyi ma'i shing rta la gnas pa/ sprin kha dog sna lnga'i gseb na bzhugs pa/ spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ phyag gis zla ba dang nyi ma za ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ byang shar du dz+yoḥlas mjug rings dkar po klu'i gzugs can thal mo sbyar ba'o// gzhan yang drang srong gi tshogs dang rgyu skar gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ shar du yul 'khor srung ser po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du rnam thos sras ser po ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de bzhi ka'ang rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gza' yum gtso 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la rnam snang*/

'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mtha' mar sngags phreng gi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥm hā

sa paṇa dang 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs sogs su/ oṃ sarba bid+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'byung zhing*/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung du'ang sngar bzhin la/ phaṭa gcig las med pa dpe ma dag pa yin snyam/ 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs su/ nye snying*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa t+yai swā hā/ zhes pa dang gong gi snying po gang mos bzla gsungs/ bi d+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam mo// yang 'bring du byed na/ gtso mo'i mdun du gza' nyi ma gong ltar bskyed/ shin tu bsdu na gtso mo rkyang pa bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs yan rgyas pa bzhin bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma phul na/ dkar gtor gcig yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa gyur par bsam/ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gza' yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gza' yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ rtsa sngags la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod pas mchod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang mthun par brjod/ 'di'i rjes gnang byed par spro na/ mchod pa gsham lugs bdag mdun sgrub tshul sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang nyid dran pa gso ba'i phyir du dge slong byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes bkod pa'o// ༈ /bstod pa ni/ thabs shes dbyer med pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// sgrib gnyis mun bcom ye shes zla 'od 'chang*// sku gsum zhal dang phyin drug rang bzhin phyag

/mtshan dpes rab mdzes rgyal yum khyod la bstod// ces gtso mo dang*/ gang thugs gnyis med ye shes rjes 'brang bas// rang rang zlos gar cha lugs du mas mdzes// 'tshe ba'i skyon bral bden pa'i don mthong nas// bstan 'gro skyong mdzad srung ma'i tshogs la bstod// ces pas 'khor la'o// bstod pa 'di gzhung gi nyer mkhor bstan rdor gyis bris so// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gza' yum 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga nad gdon mun pa sel ba'i ma zlum zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang dag thugs rje'i yid 'phrog rkang pa'i rtses// bsnun tsam nyid nas dge legs mya ngan med// srid zhi'i phan dang bde ba'i 'dab ma stong*// rnam grol byed pa dkon mchog gsum la 'dud// su zhig mthun pa'i rdzas kyis dgyes bskyed pas// gnas skabs nad gdon bar chad kun bsal nas// bde dga'i 'bras bu sbyin la mthu che ba// mchod 'os mchod pa'i cho ga brten las 'byung*// de yang rgyal dang rgyal sras mkhas rnams kyi// zhal lung rnam dag mthu yin rang dgas min// rgyu rkyen gnyen por mkhas pa'i 'tsho byed kyis// nad med bde ba ster gyi gzhan pas ci// 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'gran zla dang bral zhing mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa'i dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i gsung gi man ngag 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyan dam pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho las brgyud pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpal sa skya pa chen po las 'ongs pa'i gza' thams cad kyi yum gyi mchod pa'i cho ga mngon sum du byin rlabs 'byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba 'di bri bar bya'o// 'di 'bri ba la gnyis te/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ de ltar byas pa'i phan yon no// dang po la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go /dang po la bzhi ste/ gang du bya ba'i gnas bstan pa dang*/ gang bya ba'i dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/

der gzhag pa'i bum pa bca' ba dang*/ lha rnams mchod pa'i yo byad bsham pa'o// dang po ni bkra shis shing yid dga' ba'i gnas su byi dor byas la/ steng du bla re la sogs pas brgyan no// phyogs su dar dang rin po che la sogs pa'i 'phyang 'phrul lo// zur du ba dan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'o// 'og gi sa gzhi la dri zhim pos sbags pa'i lci ba'am dri bzang gi chus byugs par bya'o// gnyis pa gang bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni srad bus thig legs par btab la/ sgo la sogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi cha tshad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ phyi rol du 'khor yug zlum skor dang*/ de'i phyir rdo rwa me ri bcas pa'i zlum skor re bya/ de dag gi tshon gyi kha dog rnams spyi ltar ci mdzes bya/ de'i dbus su pad+ma'i lte ba la sor bcu gnyis/ 'dab ma la sor bcu gnyis te sor nyer bzhi pa'am/ yang na lte ba la drug 'dab ma la drug ste sor bcu gnyis pa gang rung bris la de'i dbus kyi lte ba la nyi ma'i gur gum/ phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad du byas pa'i shar du zla ba'i tsan+dan dkar po/ me ru mig dmar gyi tsan+dan dmar po/ lhor gza' lhag gi de pa dā ru/ bden bral du phur bu'i gur gum/ nub tu pa wa sangs kyi tsan+dan dkar po/ rlung du spen pa'i a ga ru nag po/ byang du sgra gcan gyi tsan+dan dmar po dang a ga ru bsres pa/ dbang ldan du 'jug rings kyi tsan+dan dkar po dang a ga ru bsres pa/ shar gyi sgor gur gum/ lhor tsan+dan dmar po/ nub tu tsan+dan dkar po/ byang du rgya spos so// kha dog ni shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu byas kyang nyes pa med do// phyi rol gyi pha gu dang*/ 'dod snam dang*/ drwa ba dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ rta babs la sogs pa gzhan ltar rgyas par bya ba'am/ ma byas kyang nyes pa med gsungs pa ni tshom bu dgod pa la dgongs sam snyam/ gal te byed na dkyil 'khor phyi phyed nang phyed du byas te/

nang gi pad+ma la sor bcu gnyis byas la phyi rol yang de tsam mo// nang du nyi shu rtsa bzhi byas na phyi rol yang nyi shu rtsa bzhir bya'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor du gzhag pa'i bum pa ni rgyas par byed na gza' dgu la bum pa dgu/ rje btsun ma la gcig ste bcu bca' ba'am/ de tsam ma 'byor na bum pa gcig bca' la/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings gzungs rdor dung chos dang bcud legs par gzhug go /bzhi pa mchod pa'i yo byad ni gser ram dngul lam zangs sam/ dung chos sam/ ma 'byor na rdza'i snod du chu gtsang ma la mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bkang ste mchod yon/ gza' re re la mchod pa re re bsham/ de bzhin du snod de dag tu dri zhim po'i chus bkang ba'i zhabs bsil dang*/ yang nyi ma dang zla ba'i mchod yon chu sbrang rtsi 'bras dkar po'o// mig dmar gyi byu ru tsan+dan dmar po chu dang bsre/ gza' lhag gi mar dang nas bsres pa'i chu'o// phur bu'i gur gum gyi chu'o// pa wa sangs kyi mu tig shel tsan+dan gyi chu bsres pa'o// spen pa'i sran ma mar nag dang chu bsres pa'o// sgra gcan gyi mu man til nag chu dang bsres pa'o// mjug rings kyi gla rtsi til dkar nag chu dang bsres pa'o// snod rnams kyang dkar po rnams kyi dngul lam dung*/ ser po'i gser/ dmar po'i zangs/ nag po'i 'khar ba'am zha nye'o// ma 'byor na thams cad rdza las bya'o// gza' rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me tog dbul lo// bdug spos ni nyi ma'i thang shing gi thang chu'o// zla ba'i ga bur ram nā ga ge sar ka ra dang bcas pa'o// mig dmar gyi gu gul nag po'o// gza' lhag gi gu gul dkar po'am/ gu gul dkar po dang de ba dā ru bsres pa'o// phur bu'i sbrang rtsi'am/ sna tshogs pa sbyar ba'o// pa wa sangs kyi thang chu'am/ a ga ru dang tu ru ṣ+ka'o// spen pa'i gan+dha ri'i sbos sam/ sa 'og gi spos so// sgra gcan gyi bil ba'am/

po so cha'i bdug pa'o/ mjug rings kyi tsan+dan dang bil ba bsres pa'am/ mar dang rgya skyegs yung ba gsum bsres pa'o// mar me ni mar dkar la sdong bu dri ma med pa sbar ba'o// so so la dri zhim pa'i chu dbul lo// zhal zas ni nyi ma'i 'o thug go /zla ba'i zho zan no// mig dmar gyi bu ram dang sran ma sha'o// gza' lhag gi mar gyi khur ba'o// phur bu'i zho dang 'o ma'o// pa wa sangs kyi bu ram gyi khur ba dang bcas pa'o// spen pa'i sran mut+ga ma sha dang bcas pa'am/ sran ma 'bru mar dang bcas pa'o// sgra gcan gyi til gyi thug pa'o// mjug rings kyi til gyi thug pa dang bu ram gyi tshod ma'o// dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du yul 'khor srung gi zho zan/ 'phags skyes po'i zho dang sran ma sha'i bza' ba/ mig mi bzang gi 'o thug lus ngan po'i zho dang sran ma sha bur chang dang bcas pa'o// gza' rnams kyi ni mar zan no// khyim rnams dang rgyu skar rnams kyi zho zan no// gnod pa rnams kyi sran ma sha'i bza' ba'o// thams cad la bdug pa gu gul dkar po'o// gza' sogs kyi mchod pa de rnams rang rang gi phyogs su tshang bar bsham/ dbang ldan nas shar lho'i bar la rje btsun ma dang gza' spyi la zlum gtor gnyis dang cha gsum gtor ma rnams rim par bsham mo// de nas so so'i kha dog dang bstun pa'i dar thod dang ba dan yang dpyang bar bya'o// sbyor ba'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ mdun du bskyed pa dang*/ de la mchod pa dang*/ bzlas nas mdo gdon pa'o// dang po ni snga dro'i tshe sngar bshad pa'i yo byad rnams bshams nas khrus byas te stan bde ba la 'dug la/ spyi'i mchod pa byin rlabs tshe dpag med sogs gzhan ltar bya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrungs la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar dang*/ de nas snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/

de las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas te/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas mdun du spyan drangs pa de la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo bhaṭ+ṭa ra kā ma hā bi d+yā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ma hā bi d+yā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa stong pa nyid du bsgom/ de nas stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gza' thams cad kyi yum ston zla ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal dang po dkar ba/ g.yas gnag pa/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma rig pa chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bdag la bstim mo// slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs te chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nad dang bar du gcod pa rnams sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas rang la thim/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi gdug pa'i sems zhi bar byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ma hā bi d+yā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa t+yai swā hā/ zhes nye snying gang mos la ci nus su bzlas mthar 'dod don gsol zhing*/ mtheb srin se gol bcas pas/ oṃ ma hā bi d+yā badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ rang ngam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o// dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa mdun du bskyed pa la gnyis te/ bum pa la bskyed pa dang rdul tshon la bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar bcas pa'i bum pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba sogs nas nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po sogs nas bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/

bum pa gzhan la gza' rnams bskyed chog dang rang sngags kyis ye shes pa bstim pa sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// bum pa gcig tu byed na pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po sogs nas gtso mo gong ltar bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i mdun du oṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma lus sin+dhū ra'i phung po ltar shin tu dmar ba phyag gnyis pad+ma'i sdong bu dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das ma la thal mo sbyar te bka' nod pa'i tshul du 'dug pa zhi ba'i bzhin can sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba sogs nas/ oṃ ku ma rā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar 'og ma bzhin dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir shar du yul 'khor srung dkar po sogs nas/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā'i bar 'og ma bzhin dang*/ de dag gi mtshams rnams su khyim dang rgyu skar dang gnod pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor bar bsams la/ sngags kyi dgug gzhag bcas byas la/ dbang bskur ba'i don du rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ gza' dgu dang khyim rgyu skar gnod pa'i tshogs rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa sogs rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/

oṃ ma hā bi d+yā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mai gholbā ya swā hā/ oṃ shi tāṃ sha be swā hā/ oṃ rak+ta aṃ ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ budhā ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ ha spa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swā hā/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be swā hā/ zhes pas bcom ldan 'das ma gza' dgu dang bcas pa/ oṃ bud+dha ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma dhā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku ma rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas nang sgo'i lha bzhi dang*/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ oṃ bai rū ḍha kā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ oṃ sarba gra hā ṇāṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba dwā da sha rā shī nāṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba nak+ṣa trā ṇāṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pas 'khor yug gi lha rnams kyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas mthar mchod bstod mdor bsdus 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma gza' dang rgyu skar gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum par blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu bas bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces brjod do// bum pa'i steng du rin po che'i snod du ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten bzhag la/ sngar bsgrubs zin pa'i bum pa yod na mchod rten la me long bstan par/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus byas pa'i khrus chu bum par blugs pa 'dra zhig bshad mod/ khrus 'di ma byung yang dbang bskur byas pas 'gal ba med par sems so// gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes brjod la stong par bsgoms la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa sogs nas/ rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis spras pa zhes pa'i bar tshe dpag med ltar las/ khyad par rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug yod pa nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po sogs nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gtso mo gza' yum bdag bskyed skabs bzhin bskyed la/ oṃ sarba bi d+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ de nas de'i mdun du gza' rnams bskyed par bya ste/ ām̐ las byung ba'i gza' nyi ma lus sin+dhū ra'i phung po ltar shin tu dmar ba lag pa gnyis pad+ma'i sdong bu dang bcas te bcom ldan 'das ma la thal mo sbyar te bka' nod pa'i tshul du 'dug pa/ zhi ba'i bzhin can shin tu mdzes pa lo sum cu lon pa'i cha lugs can/ rtas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na gnas pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ me gholkā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rang 'dra spyan drangs la bstim/ shar du am̐ las byung ba'i zla ba gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ lag pa gnyis na ku mu ta'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ chags pa'i nyams can shin tu mdzes pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i cha lugs can/ dad pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na gnas pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ shaṃ tāṃ sha be swā hā/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim pa man chad kyang rigs 'gre/ me'i mtshams su ram̐ las byung ba'i mig dmar rgya skyegs ltar dmar ba/ lag pa g.yas na gri gug g.yon na mi mgo rlon pa 'dzin pa/ mig dmar zhing mi 'dzum pa/ lus thung ba lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i cha byad can ra skyes la zhon par bsams la/ o rak+ta aṃ ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lhor bum las byung ba'i gza' lhag margad ljang gu lag pa gnyis na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i bzhin can shin tu mdzes pa lo sum cu rtsa bzhi lon pa'i cha byad can/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can pad+ma'i steng na bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ bud+dhā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bden bral du pṛṃ las byung ba'i phur bu gser ltar ser ba/ lag pa gnyis na phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ thugs rje can lo bcu drug lon pa'i cha byad can glang po che'i steng na gnas par bsams la/ oṃ bṛ ha spa ta ye swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nub tu oṃ las byung ba'i pa wa sangs shel ltar dkar ba lag pa gnyis na phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sha rgyas pa bzhad cing 'dzum pa'i bzhin can lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga lon pa'i nyams can pad+ma'i steng na bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rlung du sham̐ las byung ba'i spen pa/ mig sman ltar gnag pa/ lag pa gnyis na phreng ba dang dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ skra zed pa rkang pa 'thing zhing 'jigs pa/ khyi'i pags pa'i smad g.yogs can/ lo lnga bcu lon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ sbrul la zhon par bsams la/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇa ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ byang du ram̐ las byung ba'i sgra gcan dmar nag lte ba man chad gnag pa/ lag pa gnyis na nyi zla 'dzin par bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang ldan du kaṃ las byung ba'i mjug rings dud sprin gyi mdog can lag na sbrul zhags dang ral gri 'dzin pa/

rid cing 'jigs pa skra steng du brdzes pa/ brag gi steng na bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgo'i nang gi phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du/ shar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsum gsol ba/ oṃ bud+dhā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lhor phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ byang du 'jam pa'i dbyangs dmar ser ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ku ma rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol 'khor yug gi shar du yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ bai rū ḍha kā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nub tu mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣa ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ byang du lus ngan po ser po rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de dag gi bar mtshams kun tu gza' dang khyim dang rgyu skar gnod pa'i tshogs dang bcas te 'khod par gyur/ oṃ sarba gra ha dwā da sha rā shi nak+ṣa tra u pa dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes pas ye shes pa gzhug 'di dag gi ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i tshul yang lha re re bzhin bskyed zin pa dang*/ rang gnas nas spyan drangs la sngags brjod cing so sor bstim pa'i tshul yin par shes par bya'o// dbang bskur ba'i don du rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ gza' dgu dang khyim dang rgyu skar dang gnod pa'i tshogs rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ de dag ni mdun du bskyed pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa de la mchod pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i mchod pa rnams la oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pa brjod pas bsangs la/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes pas sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i spyi dang bye brag so so'i mchod pa'i yo byad mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ cod pan/ ba dan/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ ka āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ma hā bi d+yā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ nai wi d+ya'i rjes su/ mu ku ṭa dang*/ pa taṃ ka zhes bcug cing*/ de nas shab+da rol mor bcas pas rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas gtso mo dang mchod yul spyi la dbul/

khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ mai gholkā ya ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya mu ku ṭa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya pa taṃ ka āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mai gholkā ya shap+da rol mor bcas pas nyi ma'i mchod pa dang*/ de'i rigs 'gre bar/ oṃ shi tāṃ sha be ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis zla ba dang*/ oṃ rak+ta aṃ ga ku mā rā ya ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mig dmar/ oṃ bu dhā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis lhag pa/ oṃ bṛ ha sba tā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phur bu/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis pa sangs/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis spen pa/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis sgra gcan/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mjug rings la phul bas de dag mnyes par bsam mo// des mchod pa'i cho ga bstan zin to// bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog ster ba// rig pa chen mor phyag 'tshal bstod// sin+dhū ra yi mchog lta bu// pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba'i 'od// rta bdun shing rta la zhon pa'i// rdo rje nyi mar bdag phyag 'tshal// kun+da kha ba lta bu ste// 'bras bu smin sogs kyis 'tsho ba// ngang pa'i bzhon par yang dag gnas// zla ba la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// skyon bral mchog ste kun nas me// ra skyes la zhon mdung 'chang zhing*// gzhon nu'i rigs las yang dag byung*// mig dmar la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// gi hang gi ni 'od dang mnyam// lag na mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing*// zhi ba pad+ma'i steng na gnas// lhag pa la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// glang po'i bdag po la zhon zhing*// ston pa po ste gser gyi 'od// rin chen snod dang phreng 'dzin phyag

/tshig bdag la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// sna tshogs ston par legs par 'byed// dkar ser snang zhing rta la zhon// bum pa dang ni phreng ba'i phyag /lha min bla mar bdag phyag 'tshal// lus rtsub sngo bsangs snang ba ni// rus sbal lus ni yang dag gnon// kha dog gnag cing lag na mdung*// dal 'gro la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// gnyis skyes gshin rje mi rnams ni// shin tu 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed// lus phyed mkhar gnas zla ba ni// gzir byed de la bdag phyag 'tshal// phyag na ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// lus kyi phyed ni mjug mas brgyan// rnam bkra ri mo'i lus su snang*// 'od kyi tog la bdag phyag 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// lnga pa bzlas nas mdo gdon pa la/ thog mar gsang sngags bzla ba dang*/ de nas mdo gdon pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ oṃ ma hā bi d+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mai gholkā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar bshad pa'i rang rang gi sngags rnams brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ji ltar nus pa lha rnams la dmigs shing ma yengs par dngos grub slong ba'i bsam pas bzla bar bya'o// gnyis pa mdo gdon pa ni/ smin drug gi zla ba'am zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bdun nas bcu bzhi'i bar la bdun bdun gdon la bco lnga'i nyin mtshan thog thag gdon par bya'o// yang na de tsam gyi yo byad ma 'dzom pa'am/ dus khyad par can gzhan nam/ rang gi bar chad zhi ba'am 'dod pa bsgrub pa'i don du nyin gcig kho na'am/ gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa mchod pa byed na'ang lan bdun kho nar gdon par bya'o// dngos gzhi'i cho ga bstan zin to// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la bzhi ste/ sdig pa zhi bar byed pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ yongs su mnyes par byed pa'i gtor ma dang*/

lhag chad kha bskangs te gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bsdus nas rjes la bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ste/ cho ga gzhan dang mthun te logs su shes par bya'o// gal te ma 'byor na'ang nyes pa med do// gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bran pa la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ kham̐ las byung ba'i gtor ma lha'i zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das ma la mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bstod pa gong ltar dang*/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gza' gzhan rnams la so so'i sngags thams cad kyi mjug tu/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum bdun gang rung gis phul la/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ gtor ma gzhan rnams 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ phyogs skyong dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ bgegs rnams la sbyin pa cha gsum spyi ltar ro// gal te nad pa sogs la khrus byed na/ sbyong ba gsum sngon du 'gro bas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags sngon du 'gro bas/ sbyin bdag che ge mo'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sogs kyis bum pa'i chus bkru ba dang*/ yang sngags la a pa nā ya sogs btags pa sgro mdongs bcas pas byabs pa dang*/ sngags rnams kyi mthar rak+ṣa btags pas spyi bor rgya gram dang*/ sbyin bdag che ge mo'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥrak+ṣas snying ga sogs su rgya gram gyis srung ba sogs rnam 'joms ltar dang*/

rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing sngags rnams kyi mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// gza' yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs kyis// sogs bden stobs dang shis brjod rnams byas pas 'grub bo// gsum pa rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ oṃ bha ga wa tī sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra mahā rā dzā ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ de bzhin du sngags rnams re re'i sngon du 'gro ba nas/ nai bi d+ya'i bar dang*/ de nas mu ku ṭa/ pa taṃ ka shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'jig rten skyong*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// gza' chen rgyu skar rgyal ba yi// bka' yi srung ma kun la bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ cho ga'i lhag chad kha skong ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa brjod nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun khyed kyis bzod par mdzod// ces brjod la bzod par gsol te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// rang rang gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas se gol gtogs la rdul mtshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs su gsol te/ sprul pa rang la bsdu zhing*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gza' yum 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun dang*// bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen bco lnga sogs// lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi// 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyi mjug rnams kyi 'dod gsol la nye bar zhi gyur cig

ces smon lam du kha bsgyur ba dang bcas te bsngo ba smon lam gang shes dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// bzhi pa ni sngar bris pa'i spos kyi dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas rnams bsdus te 'bab chu'am/ khron pa la sogs par dor la/ rjes la bum pa'i chus rang dang gzhan la blud pa dang*/ bkru ba dang gtor ba la sogs pas rang dang gzhan gyi don bya'o// de dag ni mjug gi cho ga ste/ de ltar don gsum gyis ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga rnams bshad zin to// da ni spyi don gnyis pa de ltar byas pa'i phan yon la gnyis te/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gzungs nyid las lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung*/ skar mda' ltung ba dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa'i gnod pa ste/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi gnod pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo*// glog dang thog dang nad rnams sel ba dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// gza'i tshogs kyis gnod pa byas pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// rtag tu nyams su blangs na dngos grub thams cad rjes su ster bar 'gyur ro// bdag nyid kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do// thams cad srung bar byed do// bgegs dang gnod pa thams cad dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ mtshang 'bru ba dang*/ shags 'gyed pa dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ chom rkun gyi chad pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor dang*/ sngags dang*/ phye ma dang*/ dug gi sbyor ba dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams zlog par byed do// sngags kyi tshig rnams gang dag gi rna ba'i bu gas thos par gyur na/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro// de'i rigs rgyud thams cad kyi dbul ba'i gdon nyams par byed do// gnyis pa yang gzungs 'di nyid nas// skye ba dran par 'gyur ba dang*/
